name: review-loop
description: Portable adversarial review loop for Codex and other harnesses. Code Reviewer and Reality Checker always review; the initial round may add zero or multiple highly relevant Agency Agents domain experts without a seat cap. It merges findings, applies minimal fixes, checks and re-reviews them, and gives repeated blockers one fresh root-cause escalation. Missing catalog, sandbox, canonical returns, or native subagents never blocks execution; weaker hosts fall back to embedded or same-context passes.

interface.shortDescription: Iterative adversarial review loop for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Run a portable CR+RC review and fix loop over the current proposal or code change, optionally adding any number of highly relevant Agency Agents domain experts in the initial round.
defaultPrompt: Use $review-loop to review this change until it passes.
